```{r}
#Import dataframe
library(readr)

#load your csv file that contains group/demographic/site/and quality control information for each participant
data <- read.csv("insert/path/to/csv/")

#make group coded as 0 for control, 1 for patient - Only used for ABIDE
data$group <- ifelse(data$group == 2, 0, 1)

#import libraries for matching
library(MatchIt)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)

#code to created a matched dataset based on IQR, Euler Characteristic and Defect Size
match_obj_IQR <- matchit(group ~ IQR + Euler + Defect_Size,
                     data = data, method = "optimal", distance ="glm",
                     ratio = 1, discard = "both",
                     replace = FALSE)

summary(match_obj_IQR)

# to save the matched R-studio object to access at a later date
saveRDS(match_obj_IQR, file = "name_of_file.rds")
#access the saved object from line 33
loaded_object <- readRDS("your_file.rds")

#Plot the results of matching
plot(match_obj_IQR, type = "jitter", interactive = FALSE)
plot(summary(match_obj_IQR), abs = FALSE)

#to view discarded participants
match_obj_IQR$discarded

#to save your matched data, first extract it from the object
matched_data <- match.data(match_obj_IQR)
#then save it to a csv for later use
write.csv(matched_data, "matched_data_filename.csv")
```
